title: Semivan and Kit Green question Tom DeLonge in a hotel room

tellings.quote: It was Semivan and Kate Green. They got Tom Dong in a hotel room and they said like where'd you get this stuff from?

plain: Around 2015, two intelligence insiders, a former CIA officer named Jim Semivan and a CIA scientist named Kit Green, are said to have sat the rock musician Tom DeLonge down in a hotel room and asked him where he was getting his information about UFOs. The researcher Grant Cameron tells this to Michels without naming a source. The point of the story is that people inside government wanted to know how an outsider had come by what he knew.
